matching.hc_quiescence: exact empty JSON object from session/status; arrays and scalars are protocol errors
matching.json_equality: recursive type-exact JSON; bool, integer and float are distinct; object key order is irrelevant
matching.tool_receipt: exact declared step.capture projection; full raw payload preserved
matching.text_bindings: only names listed in normalize_bindings; numeric business values never normalized

fsm_history_time.rule: ISO8601; nondecreasing across each stored stack

matching.gate_reason: Allow omits reason_code; Deny equals the exact declared step.gate_reason

daemon_time.rule: inside correlated HC tool span; 1ms timestamp rounding tolerance

matching.ordering: actor/step keyed; selected consumed messages identity keyed; no global concurrent event ordering
matching.raw_logs: retain all; compare complete explicitly correlated gate and transition ledger events
matching.unknown_fields: retain and exact-match within each declared captured object
